name: code-editor
title: CodeEditor
description: A code editor on Monaco for JSON, YAML, Protobuf, jq, plain text and languages an app registers, loaded lazily from the app's own bundle (no CDN, no network), themed from the editor.* and syntax.* tokens of its region, with JSON Schema validation, the app's completion, markers by line and column, Mod+Enter to submit, a diff view, and a one-line mode in Fluent's input frame.

manifest.name: code-editor
manifest.title: CodeEditor
manifest.description: A code editor on Monaco for JSON, YAML, Protobuf, jq, plain text and languages an app registers, loaded lazily from the app's own bundle (no CDN, no network), themed from the editor.* and syntax.* tokens of its region, with JSON Schema validation, the app's completion, markers by line and column, Mod+Enter to submit, a diff view, and a one-line mode in Fluent's input frame.
manifest.usage: Use CodeEditor for structured text the user writes or reviews: a message payload in the Composer (language="json" with the schema's JSON Schema: validation, completion and hovers, onDiagnosticsChange for a status line), a manifest to apply (language="yaml" with diff={{ original }} to review a change), a .proto file. For a query, a filter or a JSON value on one line, set singleLine (Enter submits, line breaks become spaces) with size as Input's, and give completion for the app's own suggestions (search attributes, saved queries, fields; Ctrl+Space opens them). A language of the app's own goes through registerCodeLanguage(id, setup) in @/lib/monaco, then language="<id>". Mod+Enter calls onSubmit with the text. markers take 1-based lines and columns (a codec's, parser's or server's error position). Monaco loads on first mount; until then a textarea with the same text and keys stands in. Schemas are given, never fetched. Use SqlEditor for SQL, JsonViewer or CodeBlock to show code.

props.name: variant
props.description: outline: a bordered field. ghost: no border, to fill a pane.

props.name: language
props.description: The grammar; JSON also loads Monaco's JSON language service and its worker. Any other string is a language registered with registerCodeLanguage (plain text until it is).

props.name: singleLine
props.description: One line in Fluent's input frame (the field's fill, hairline, bottom edge and focus underline): no gutter, scrollbars or line highlight; Enter submits unless the suggestions are open; typed or pasted line breaks become spaces.

props.name: size
props.description: singleLine only: the field's height and padding, as Input's sizes.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Danger edges on the frame (say why in a FieldError); sets data-invalid.

props.name: completion
props.description: The app's suggestions: { triggerCharacters?, provide(context) } where context is { text, offset, line, column, word, reason } and items are { label, kind?, detail?, documentation?, insertText?, snippet?, sortText?, filterText?, replace? }. They answer for this editor's model only; Ctrl+Space opens the list.

props.name: value
props.description: The text, when controlled; a new value replaces the text as one undoable edit.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial text, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole text after every change.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Mod+Enter (Ctrl+Enter, Cmd+Enter on macOS), and Enter when singleLine, with the text.

props.name: jsonSchema
props.description: JSON only: the JSON Schema the text is validated against; completion and hovers follow it. Applies to this editor's model only.

props.name: markers
props.description: The app's problems: { line, column, endLine?, endColumn?, message, severity? }, 1-based; a hover shows the message, F8 goes to the next.

props.name: onDiagnosticsChange
props.description: The language service's problems ({ line, column, message, severity }) whenever they change: JSON syntax and schema violations.

props.name: diff
props.description: Shows the text against original (side by side, inline when narrow); the original is never editable.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Text can be selected, searched and copied but not changed; sets data-readonly.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the editor is empty.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Line numbers in the gutter, in editor.gutter (never when singleLine).

props.name: tabMovesFocus
props.description: Tab moves focus out instead of indenting; Ctrl+M toggles it at any time.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the text area ("JSON editor" by default, after the language).

props.name: onEditorReady
props.description: Called once Monaco has mounted, with the (modified) editor and the Monaco API.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own; set the height here (240 px by default).

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the root element.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The editor's frame in editor.bg (singleLine: the field's frame); data-slot="code-editor", data-variant, data-language, data-single-line, data-size, data-loading, data-readonly, data-focused, data-invalid.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: The stand-in until Monaco loads, with the same text, colours and keys; data-slot="code-editor-fallback".

states.name: focused
states.description: The text area has focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame (singleLine: the field's accent underline).

states.name: loading
states.description: Monaco is loading (aria-busy); the fallback textarea works meanwhile and the pointer shows progress.

states.name: read-only
states.description: Read-only: the outline border lightens to color.border.default.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The frame's hairline and bottom edge turn color.status.danger.border and color.status.danger.stroke.

states.name: single-line
states.description: A one-line field (singleLine): Fluent's input frame and sizes; Monaco's background is transparent so the field's fill shows.

accessibility: Monaco's text area has the accessible name (aria-label, or aria-labelledby on a visible label); the fallback textarea carries the same name until Monaco has loaded.
Tab indents; Ctrl+M toggles Tab moving focus (tabMovesFocus starts in that mode) so keyboard users can leave the editor.
Problems are underlined and announced on hover and with F8; onDiagnosticsChange lets the app also show them as text.
Focus shows the double ring on the frame: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner.
singleLine: Enter submits like a form field and Tab leaves the editor; Ctrl+Space opens the suggestions, which Monaco announces as a list; set aria-label or aria-labelledby as for an Input.
